name: rich-text-editor
description: Standalone harness for the rich-text editor open questions (Epic 37698). Same Lexical version as the Prismatic frontend.

prototype.title: Rich Text Editor
prototype.description: One value through five representations, in HTML and Markdown: what the editor shows, what it saves, and what a recipient sees. Answers the review questions on chip nodes, the element allowlist, preview isolation and reference escaping.

scripts.verify: node verify-glimmer.mjs && node verify-escaping.mjs && node verify-format.mjs && node verify-roundtrip.mjs && node verify-variants.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run verify
